name: osd-battery
description: Battery charge as a percentage on the live-view information screen (top left). A new text label on the live-view panel, made by the panel's own builder from a new resource record, and one routine at the end of the panel's two refresh functions: it reads the battery voltage with the stock A/D routine under the stock semaphore, at most once in 2 s, and writes (count - 680) * 5 / 8 percent, 0 to 100, into the label. The scale is inferred from the E-PL3 and needs one camera check. A delta on data/builds/films-12d.json: every expect is a byte string of that build. See experiments/2026-11-17-osd-info/NOTES.md.
_ram: T_LAST 0x602BE8C8 (u32) and RAW 0x602BE8CC (u16): slots 21 and 22 of the 37-slot table 0x602BE874, free by the same static argument as slot 20 (focus-peaking NOTES 11.3). Child slot 0 of the live-view panel object (panel + 792) holds the label
